runtime.rule: Vehicle Totems apply only while the tactics profile phase is season6; they contribute +0.5% damage per level to the matching troop type and are zero in off-season.

awakening.scoringRule: Displayed ATK already reflects part of Awakening stat growth, but the new Awakening skill materially changes damage output. Do not treat awakening as a cosmetic checkbox; skill level and Awakening Stars must be represented before high-accuracy Code/PvE scoring.
awakening.currentRuntimeStatus: Season6 runtime flags awakened Kimberly/DVA/Tesla as pending skill-curve calibration. No unverified level 1-to-40 interpolation is applied.

heroPromotion.monsterTradeoff: SSR Braz has Zombie Killer monster-damage passive; UR Braz loses it and shifts to Promotion Synergy/PvP-oriented kit.
heroPromotion.simulatorRule: SSR and UR Braz must be distinct variants because promoting him can reduce his dedicated monster-farming bonus even while improving general combat.

tacticsCards.offSeason: Only owned Core Cards remain active; regular Battle/Resource cards are inactive.
tacticsCards.season6: Core Cards + Season 6 regular cards. Hybrid Squad (4+1) is removed.
tacticsCards.launchGuideConflict: Early S6 documentation for Frontal Suppression is stale versus the current live catalog. WfGg must use current displayed wording/values.
